caption: The drawing depicts an iron trivet rendered in grayscale. The primary object is a solid, triangular-shaped trivet with a flat top, three short legs, and an integral handle with a circular opening. The body of the trivet features an openwork design consisting of a large central heart with additional geometric elements radiating from it. There are three smaller drawings at the top left: a top-down view showing the trivet’s outline and internal cutouts, a side profile illustrating the legs, and a scale marked in inches for measurement reference. The trivet is drawn with distinct shading to indicate its three-dimensional form, and the artist's signature "H. BADER" appears at the bottom right of the image. The background is a plain, lightly textured off-white.
title: Flat Iron Holder
